body:
Greg's decision, 2026-11-06 about 00:32Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (Engram mailbox #318, forwarded by Engram::Fable in TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #6608), verbatim: «GIT operuje na diffie. NIE CHCE PRZEKAZYWANIA CALEJ LISTY PLIKOW. TO ZNOWU NIE BEDZIE DZIALAC». It applies to EO and source_id in BOTH projects: no full file or index list is derived, passed or buffered as an acceptance condition.

The committed-input predicate rev 5 this entry used to carry is superseded by the source_id definition in memory eo-option-b-canonical, which allows local changes and compares the whole object; revision 1 here keeps its text.
